title: SBM Credilio Novio Visa (FD) credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has partnered with Credilio (Visa) to offer customers seamless access to credit solutions. This collaboration allows SBM users to avail of quick, flexible financing options through Visa’s Credilio platform, enhancing their purchasing power and payment flexibility.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
